title: Engagement of early-career scientists in sustainable chemistry: science policy perspectives
content:

Lovish Raheja, Francisca J. Benítez, José Ferraz-Caetano, Maulline G. Leviev, Aanchal Saxena, Anna Isabel Becker
This perspective highlights global chemistry science-policy engagement, outlining regional gaps and priority actions. It calls for coordinated frameworks with early-career leadership to advance sustainable chemistry worldwide. Icons via Canva.com.
